explanation: At each node, compare k with its left subtree size plus one. Descend left, return the root, or descend right after subtracting the skipped left subtree and root.
timeComplexity: O(h) selection; O(n) including wrapper size conversion
spaceComplexity: O(1) selection; O(n) converted tree plus O(h) wrapper recursion
